source: Anthropic first-party API list prices, as listed in the claude-api reference cached 2026-10-06 and checked 2026-10-20. Cache writes are the 5-minute TTL (1.25x input). Haiku 5.5 cache prices are derived from the same rule (0.1x read, 1.25x write) and are marked derived.

compute.note: Local compute per item is charged at a nominal rate so arms that hold a browser longer cost more. One worker = one browser plus its share of one 4 vCPU / 16 GB host.
compute.host_source: a nominal 4 vCPU / 16 GB on-demand cloud VM, round figure; change here, never in code

labor.note: Assumptions, not measurements. People's time is priced only to put every component in one currency; the report also gives every component in minutes, and shows the total at half and double these rates.
labor.operator_source: round figure for a fully loaded US medical front-desk / registration clerk hour (wage plus overhead); assumption
labor.engineer_source: round figure for a fully loaded automation engineer hour; assumption
labor.engineer_source_times: assumed time for a skilled engineer to write and test this script (2 h) and to diagnose and fix it after one UI change (30 min); used only for the human_script arm's assumption column

drift.note: assumed for the per-1,000 projection: the soak's four UI-change kinds, once each per 1,000 items (about one vendor release per few weeks at a clinic's referral volume). The measured stream has 4 changes in 40 items; the report gives maintenance per change so any rate can be applied.
